contract_grounding.assertion_text_quoted: consistencyLevel IN {Strong,Session,Bounded,Eventually,Customized} else code==1100 (message: consistencyLevel can only be [Strong, Session, Bounded, Eventually, Customized], default: Bounded)
contract_grounding.note: ''与 null 均不在枚举域内（'Foo' 同为非成员被拒 1100），却 code:0——枚举约束对空值形态失效。violates=true；'空串=省略走默认 Bounded'的宽容解释与 'Foo 也省略不了'的不一致行为并存，留给 auditor

chain_links: doc: 枚举五值 + default Bounded（消息原文 live 复现）
script: boundary_search_consistency_enum_015.py 九个 consistencyLevel 形态 + searchParams 组

source_grounding.source_excerpt: utils.go convertConsistencyLevel：`func convertConsistencyLevel(reqConsistencyLevel string) (commonpb.ConsistencyLevel, bool, error) { if reqConsistencyLevel != "" { level, ok := commonpb.ConsistencyLevel_value[reqConsistencyLevel]; if !ok { return 0, false, merr.WrapErrParameterInvalidMsg(...) } return commonpb.ConsistencyLevel(level), false, nil } // ConsistencyLevel_Bounded default in PyMilvus; return commonpb.ConsistencyLevel_Bounded, true, nil }` —— 空串被显式视为'省略'回退默认 Bounded（注释援引 PyMilvus 行为）；JSON null 经 Go 解码为 string 零值 ""，与空串同路径。generateSearchParams（searchParams 次缺陷面）：任意 key/value 仅 fmt.Sprintf 透传（L2236-2243），无 nprobe/ef 域校验。
source_grounding.call_chain_traced: REST search -> convertConsistencyLevel('' → 默认 Bounded, useDefault=true) -> 无 1100 -> 执行；非法非空串走 ConsistencyLevel_value 查表失败 -> 1100
source_grounding.note: 空值回退默认是源码显式分支（by-design 抗辩成立）；但契约断言域为闭集且未豁免空值，contract-source 分歧如实呈现。violates=true 依据：'Foo' 同为'非成员'被拒而 ''/null 放行，行为不一致本身违反枚举契约的可判定性

mundane_explanation.surviving: by-design 空值回退默认（源码注释明示 PyMilvus 对齐）——抗辩材料

evidence_weight: strong（behavior 九形态对照含合法值 + 源码空串分支逐行定位；by-design 抗辩已标注）
